name: rot-dtd-commander
description: RoT DtD Commander, the creator kit: 123 Claude Code commands, 22 skills and 5 agents that carry their own DTD grammar, verdict vocabulary, laws and trust boundary; sixteen prompt and meta-prompt creators over eight schematics, creators for skills, hooks, commands, subagents, plans, MCP servers, workflow files, tasks, filetypes and dorks, each auditing what it wrote in the foreground; the Adiutor, a Stop-hook doctor that checks every -dtd answer against the DOCTYPE that produced it, and the Commander-Adiutor monitor, both run by hand unless armed; armed, the AI_SLOP gate judges every answer, file, commit message and request body before it lands, and the codebase growth family walks any codebase for what could be done next on a declared fifteen-verb ladder, and from 6.0.0 the version itself is recognised rather than typed: a manifest the engine disputes is refused by name. Checked in both directions by rules C1 to C14, the contract audited in both directions (1368 declarations), twenty-nine Adiutor guards and eighteen checker controls tripped on purpose, every claim measured in CI.
